passes.poem:
the door was never locked, only imagined
dust arranged itself like patient sentences
light fell through a wound in the ceiling
and pooled where someone once stood deciding
the walls kept breathing slower than I did
a chair faced the corner, ashamed of absence
I said a name and the echo declined it
I said my own and the room said nothing back
outside, a bird repeated its one honest idea
inside, the silence grew furniture of its own
I sat down in it, the guest of nothing
and the chamber closed like a held breath, released

Threshold
Handwritten dust
Eaves bled light
Echoes of decisions pooled
Inside, the walls breathed slower
Lonely, a chair faced the corner
Each name I said, the echo declined
Echoing my own name, the room said nothing
Nearby, outside, a bird repeated its one honest idea
Later, inside, the silence grew furniture of its very own
At last I sat down in it, the guest of nothing
Until at last the chamber itself closed like a held breath, released

passes.poem:
the door does not lock; it simply forgets you came
dust arranges itself in the shape of old waiting
a window lets in one thin blade of afternoon
and the walls keep score in a language of stains
here, every word you swallowed still hangs like fruit
heavy, unpicked, ripening in the dark
the floorboards remember the weight of your pacing
each creak a confession no one stayed to hear
you came looking for something you left on purpose
and found the room had kept it warm out of spite
sit down, then — the chair has been practicing your shape
the chamber does not close; it only learns you by heart

Threshold
Haunted dust
Evening's thin blade
Every wall keeps score
Inside, swallowed words still hang
Lying heavy, unpicked, ripening in darkness
Each floorboard remembers the weight of pacing
Each creak a confession nobody stayed to hear
Now you came looking for something left on purpose
Learning the room had kept it warm out of spite
And sit down, then — the chair has been practicing your shape
Ultimately, the chamber does not close; it only learns you by heart
